mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix definition would cause role-permission assertions to fail, exposing that the matrix is the foundation of all access control
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadPermissions { Customer -> DecideApplication in PermissionMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the requirement that every application has an initial audit entry causes the completeness check to fail when the model creates an application without recording its submission
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAuditEntry { some app: LoanApplication | no e: AuditEvent | e.application = app and e.previous_status = none }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the uniqueness constraint on audit events allows duplicate transition records to exist, violating the append-only invariant
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAuditEvent { some disj e1, e2: AuditEvent | e1.application = e2.application and e1.previous_status = e2.previous_status and e1.new_status = e2.new_status }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the non-empty universe constraint allows Alloy to check assertions against empty models, making them vacuously true; the injection forces concrete atoms to exist
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonEmpty { some User some LoanApplication some AuditEvent some Decision }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the predicate body causes the assertion to pass vacuously (no Decision exists to violate it); the injection creates a decision by a non-assigned officer
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongOfficerDecides { some app: LoanApplication | some d: Decision | d.application = app and d.decided_by != app.assigned_officer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the predicate causes the assertion to pass vacuously; the injection creates a customer with two simultaneous in-flight applications
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultipleInFlight { some c: User | some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.customer = c and a2.customer = c and (a1.status = Submitted or a1.status = UnderReview) and (a2.status = Submitted or a2.status = UnderReview) }
